verdict: SUPPORTED BUT BELOW THE REGISTERED LIFT THRESHOLD
note: H57: exactly-accounted core of two scored priors plus 14.8k px of two-view co-training union mass, all outside the 200m ring and all outside prior support. Not a verified fault map.

r1.reading: The union ranking field wins 16/16 fold cells against the matched random control and is rank 1 of 8 on every (instrument, budget) cell, but its absolute lift is +0.0037 to +0.0048 and the registered threshold is +0.005. The threshold is applied as written and reported as not met.

0.000785 against a matched random control of 0.001057: the worst of the eight arms tested, and below random. The stratum is kept as a labelled component of the arm and carries its own reasoning rows, but it is not the population

decisive_measure.description: Credit density of the arm's ranking field, measured against held-out catalogue under the honest protocol, against the marginal break-even density alpha*DTI at the owner's own 0.2778
decisive_measure.conditional_argument: Added mass raises DTI only while its credit density exceeds alpha*DTI. The union field measures 4.14x the random baseline, i.e. rho = 0.116 against a break-even of 0.056. The arm sits at least 3 px further from any mapped trace than the rows that measurement was taken on, so the transferred value is an UPPER bound on the arm's own density, and this is the conditional the recommendation rests on.

unscorable.description: A required-novel arm cannot be scored by this simulator at all
unscorable.evidence: Evidence built while writing scripts/validate_h57.py: with the catalogue halo removed from the candidate pool the View A field scored 0.000358 against a random control of 0.001713, because excluding the catalogue removes every pixel the truth can occupy. rho_novel is therefore a prior, not a measurement, and no arm-selection number in this repository can certify it.

board_note: registry/leaderboard_snapshot_2026-10-07.json records rank 1 = 0.3774 (team xiaofanhu), rank 7 = 0.3195 (team DARD) and the owner-reported extradr19 best of 0.2778 at rank 13. The working target of 0.3195 is rank 7, not the top.
recommendation: The structure of this artifact is verified end to end -- format, uniqueness, novelty, the ring, the set relations and the per-candidate geological reasoning all pass their registered gates, and the ranking field is the best of eight on the only holdout that can measure anything. R1's absolute +0.005 lift threshold is not met (best +0.0048). Upload is therefore a judgement call, not a gate pass: P(this file scores below the owner's own 0.2778) = 0.83 under the registered prior, and P(above 0.3195) = 0.36.
caveats: No number here is a leaderboard forecast. Spearman(reported score, simulated DTI) = -0.1045 (p=0.734, n=13) in knowledge/10 section 5.
